parameters.help_en: The ID of the data synchronization or change tracking task
parameters.name: dts_job_id

parameters.help_en: The synchronization or subscribe instance ID
parameters.name: dts_instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The synchronization direction. Valid values:

Forward: forward.
Reverse: reverse.

Default value: Forward.
You can set this parameter to Reverse to reset the reverse synchronization task only if the topology of the data synchronization instance is two-way synchronization

Forward：正向。
Reverse：反向。

默认取值为Forward。
当数据同步实例的拓扑为双向时，才可以传入Reverse以重置反向同步链路
